title: HotSweepPointInput
description:
The input to `hot_sweep_point.py`: one hot sweep point's measurements, and
the offset to subtract from its voltage.

current_resolution_amps.description:
The supply's current readback resolution in amperes, for the
quantisation floor.

offset_voltage_volts.description: The scope's reading with no current on the point's vertical scale.

voltage_volts.description: The voltage, before the offset is subtracted.

Measurement.description:
A measured quantity: the samples taken, and the value derived from them.

`value` and `uncertainty` are the mean and standard error returned by
`mean_and_standard_error.py`, not calculated in Rust.

This is the shape every measured field takes, and the unit goes in the name
of the field holding it — `filament_voltage_volts: Measurement` — since the
consumer is another program with no doc comments to read.

samples.description: The individual samples, in the order they were taken.

uncertainty.description: The standard error of the mean.
